name: TM
recent: TM 公布 2026 财年第三季业绩，净利同比下滑至 RM494.04 million，同时宣布每股 10 仙的第三次中期股息。公司获得监管批准，推进价值 RM2.7 billion 的海底电缆项目。此外，KWAP 和 EPF 近期有多项股权变动申报。
notable: 公布 2026 财年第三季业绩，净利同比下滑至 RM494.04 million。
宣布第三次中期股息每股 10 仙，除息日为 2026 年 12 月 8 日。
获得监管批准，推进价值 RM2.7 billion 的海底电缆项目。
risks: KWAP 和 EPF 近期有多项股权变动申报。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季净利为 RM494.04 million，低于去年同期的 RM544.7 million；营收同比增长 3.3%。

recent_en: TM reported a lower 3Q 2026 net profit of RM494.04 million and declared a third interim dividend of 10 sen per share. The company received regulatory approval for its RM2.7 billion submarine cable project. Meanwhile, KWAP and EPF filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interests.
notable_en: Reported 3Q 2026 results with net profit declining year-on-year to RM494.04 million.
Declared a third interim dividend of 10 sen per share, with ex-date on 8 December 2026.
Received regulatory approval for the RM2.7 billion submarine cable project.
risks_en: KWAP and EPF filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interests recently.
earnings_en: 3Q 2026 net profit was RM494.04 million, lower than RM544.7 million a year ago; revenue grew 3.3% year-on-year.
